translations.web: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
translations.bsb: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
translations.kjv: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
translations.asv: Know ye that Jehovah, he is God: It is he that hath made us, and we are his; We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
